description: This file contains functions for parsing and transforming locators and selectors used in Playwright testing framework, including handling of locator strings, escaping, and conversion to selector engines.

methods.name: parseLocator
methods.description: Parses a locator string into a selector and preferred quote, handling various locator syntaxes and escaping.

methods.name: countParams
methods.description: Counts the number of parameters in a template string.

methods.name: shiftParams
methods.description: Adjusts parameter indices in a template string by a given offset.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms a locator template into a selector string, handling filters, nested locators, and parameter substitution.

methods.name: locatorOrSelectorAsSelector
methods.description: Converts a locator string to a selector string, with error handling.

methods.name: unsafeLocatorOrSelectorAsSelector
methods.description: Attempts to parse a locator as a selector; if invalid, transforms it into a selector if possible.

methods.name: digestForComparison
methods.description: Creates a normalized digest of a locator string for comparison purposes.
